userDecision.condition: No immediate SSO/SAML requirement. Clerk approved via GATE-1.

GATE-1.name: SSO/SAML
GATE-1.rule: IF mandatory SSO/SAML within 0-6 months → escalate to Auth0/Okta. ELSE → Clerk is approved.

GATE-2.name: MFA
GATE-2.rule: MFA alone does NOT force Auth0. Clerk and Auth0 both support MFA. Decision point is enterprise SSO/IdP/procurement.
GATE-2.current: Verify Clerk project settings and selected plan.

GATE-3.name: Clerk Organizations
GATE-3.rule: Use Clerk Organizations for agency context. Keep QUANLYVKS DB authoritative for permissions.
GATE-3.current: Clerk org role is coarse context only.

GATE-4.name: Clerk Roles/Permissions
GATE-4.rule: Do NOT rely solely on Clerk org roles for legal/business authorization. Use QUANLYVKS DB as authoritative source.
GATE-4.current: DB roles/permissions + API guards are authoritative.

GATE-5.name: API Security
GATE-5.rule: All sensitive API calls must validate Clerk JWT/Bearer token. Never trust client-provided agencyId without verifying membership.
GATE-5.current: Bearer token validation required in API guards.

clerk.mitigation: Keep permission logic in DB; use Clerk only for authN
